crossRefs.note: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.
Wherever the children of men dwell, he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand, and…
far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that…
He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.
“I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was ancient of days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair…
His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

translations.web: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.
translations.bsb: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy and black as a raven.
translations.kjv: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.
translations.asv: His head is as the most fine gold; His locks are bushy, and black as a raven.
